en.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Nativity, Mulagumoodu
en.summary: A pilgrimage church near the Tamil Nadu-Kerala border raised to minor basilica status in 2020.
en.body: Located near Kuzhithurai close to the Tamil Nadu-Kerala border, the shrine at Mulagumoodu has long drawn pilgrims devoted to the Nativity of Mary and was elevated to minor basilica status in 2020.
